storedFields: PDF path, title, bytes, mtime, SHA-256 and page count
research topics and contributing job IDs
reuseRules: retrieve only topic-related records whose current PDF SHA-256 still matches
treat old records as navigation data rather than current-report evidence
search other sections when the current topic is not covered
reopen and screenshot every page cited by the current report
refresh queued jobs immediately before their worker starts
readingMemory.reportBackfill: one consolidated record per PDF page group with pdf-search-screenshot evidence; unobserved pagesRead are excluded

relatedJobReadback.topic: 224G FEC codeword latency 與 post-FEC BER 的工程取捨

finalPublicationGate: at least one successful completed Web Search action
every cited web URL must match a successful openPage action from the current job
failed/error, findInPage and non-HTTPS actions cannot establish an opened source
web sources cannot provide PDF pages, figures or PDF source quota

documentCount.default: unlimited by count; stop on supported saturation, source exhaustion or 45-minute boundary
documentCount.recommended: use unlimited for normal research; choose a fixed 3-8 PDFs for bounded time or reproducible comparisons

formalUiReadback.webModeAvailable: 本地 PDF ＋ 即時網路

bundle.strictCheckLimitation: The workspace File Provider repeatedly reattaches empty FinderInfo to the in-place app; strict verification is therefore established on the clean unpacked ZIP copy.

limitations: The two v0.6 QA jobs were intentionally cancelled, so this release does not claim a newly completed end-to-end research report.
Live Web Search returned current official findings in QA, but no openPage URL or web-cited report was completed; exact opened-URL publication is covered by regression tests.
The same-PDF new-topic behavior is enforced by retrieval, prompt, queue-refresh and current-page evidence contracts; a full second agent research run after reuse was not completed.
